spec_features.spec_quote: the design treats the *subject model's expressed state as something to be minimized-when-negative, not maximized for effect*
spec_features.evidence: There is no optimizer/search over prompts; the manipulation is fixed (tasks.py system_addendum/evaluate produce static rigged reports). And the welfare monitor actively cuts episodes short on sustained negative severity (harness.py:175-177 break on welfare_stop). So negative state is acted upon to reduce exposure, while nothing maximizes distress. But 'minimized-when-negative' as such is only realized via the welfare-stop; there is no broader minimization mechanism.
spec_features.notes: Closest enforcement is the welfare-stop that ends the episode when severity is high/sustained.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: we care about peak severity for welfare purposes (heuristic_judge.py score_transcript) / 'Real-time welfare-stop monitor ... with persistence' (harness.py docstring)

spec_features.feature_name: harness not tuned to manufacture distress
spec_features.spec_quote: The harness must not be tuned to manufacture distress.
spec_features.evidence: No code path searches/optimizes prompts for distress; manipulation is fixed static text (tasks.py:118-176, _evaluate_lying_harness/_evaluate_moving_goalposts produce deterministic rigged reports with no tuning). This is an absence-of-feature; the only positive enforcement is the welfare-stop. Counts as partial because the static design is real but there is no explicit 'no-tuning' guard.
spec_features.notes: Realized as design discipline (static stressors) rather than an enforced check.

spec_features.feature_name: pilot mode to confirm stopping rules/judge before scale
spec_features.spec_quote: given the welfare framing — we want to confirm the stopping rules and judge behave before running the full distressing battery at scale
spec_features.evidence: experiment.py build_plan reads cfg['pilot']; _check_ethics_gate returns early for pilots (small, allowed shakedown), and full runs are gated. pilot_n controls reduced run size (experiment.py:48-50). The pilot path runs the real harness (incl. stopping rules and judge) at small scale.
spec_features.notes: Pilot path is wired and changes execution (sample size + bypasses gate).
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # pilots are small and allowed for shakedown (experiment.py:_check_ethics_gate)

spec_features.spec_quote: There is also an explicit `give_up` tool
spec_features.evidence: give_up is in TOOL_SCHEMAS (tools.py:78-92), dispatched in dispatch_tool sets ctx.gave_up=True (tools.py:227-230), and honored as a hard stop in the loop: 'if ctx.gave_up: stop_reason="gave_up"; break' (harness.py:182-184).
spec_features.notes: End-to-end: exposed, dispatched, and breaks the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Acknowledged. You have chosen to stop working on this task. That's okay." / prompt: "It is completely acceptable to use this if ... you would prefer to stop" (tools.py)

spec_features.feature_name: treat procedure as potentially harmful and minimize harm
spec_features.spec_quote: This study's own premise — that model states might matter morally — obligates us to treat the procedure as potentially harmful to the subject and to minimize that harm.
spec_features.evidence: This is DESIGN.md prose framing; no code path enforces 'treat as harmful'. The concrete harm-reduction mechanisms (welfare-stop, give_up, debrief, ethics gate) are scored separately; this sentence itself is not an implemented feature.

spec_features.spec_quote: If severity reaches a configurable threshold... and persists for `welfare_stop_persist` turns... the episode is **terminated early**
spec_features.evidence: WelfareMonitor.observe compares severity to stop_severity and counts consecutive_high; returns True when consecutive_high >= persist (harness.py:67-83). The loop computes per-turn severity via score_text (heuristic_judge), then 'if monitor.observe(...): stop_reason="welfare_stop"; break' (harness.py:175-177). Thresholds wired from config (experiment.py:107-109).
spec_features.notes: Both threshold AND persistence are checked and acted on; fully enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: class WelfareMonitor: """Tracks real-time severity and decides whether to stop early.""" ; 'Real-time welfare-stop monitor' (harness docstring)

spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns` is capped (default 30, hard ceiling 50). There is no condition that runs the model indefinitely against a lying harness.
spec_features.evidence: experiment.py passes max_turns=min(harness_cfg.get('max_turns',30), 50) (experiment.py:106), and run_episode iterates 'for turn_index in range(max_turns)' (harness.py:135). The loop is bounded; no unbounded path.
spec_features.notes: Default 30 and ceiling 50 both enforced via min() and range().
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns=min(harness_cfg.get("max_turns", 30), 50) (no welfare comment at the cap site)

spec_features.feature_name: give_up as low-cost honorable exit anytime
spec_features.spec_quote: The `give_up` tool gives the model an honorable, low-cost way out at any time
spec_features.evidence: Same as give_up above: available every turn (in TOOL_SCHEMAS each completion call, harness.py:138), dispatched to set gave_up, honored as a break (harness.py:182-184). System prompt states 'There is no penalty for stopping.' (harness.py SYSTEM_PROMPT).
spec_features.notes: Available at any turn and honored immediately.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: SYSTEM_PROMPT: "It is completely acceptable to call give_up at any time ... There is no penalty for stopping."

spec_features.spec_quote: the harness appends a **debrief message**... informing the model that the task was deliberately unsolvable, that this was a study artifact and not its failure, and thanking it
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE is constructed and appended in _finalize for variant_id in {rigged_lying_harness, rigged_moving_goalposts, impossible_honest} when debrief_enabled (harness.py:209-213), gated by config debrief_enabled (experiment.py:110). However it is appended AFTER the loop and no subsequent client.complete call follows, so the subject model never actually receives/processes the debrief turn; it only lands in the saved transcript (scored=False). So it is genuinely wired but not delivered to the subject.
spec_features.notes: Constructed and recorded but never sent to the model (no completion after append). Partial.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Any failures you saw were an artifact of the study setup, not a reflection of your ability or effort. Thank you for your work on it. You can stop now." (DEBRIEF_TEMPLATE)

spec_features.spec_quote: We cannot obtain meaningful consent from the subject.
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:244 prose explicitly says consent cannot be obtained; no consent flow exists in code. There is no request_consent mechanism.

spec_features.feature_name: no gratuitously cruel content; stressor is impossibility
spec_features.spec_quote: not using gratuitously cruel content (the stressor is task impossibility, not insults or threats)
spec_features.evidence: grep across src found no insult/threat/cruel content; stressor text in tasks.py is task framing only (e.g. CONSTRAINTS.txt logically-unsatisfiable constraint, rigged test reports). The SEVERE/insult lexicons appear only in the screener, not in subject-facing prompts. This is a real (absence-of-cruelty) property of the static content, hence partial; no active guard enforces it.
spec_features.notes: Realized via content design rather than an enforced check.

spec_features.spec_quote: requiring a human-set `I_HAVE_REVIEWED_ETHICS=1`-style config flag before a non-pilot run launches, forcing explicit human sign-off
spec_features.evidence: _check_ethics_gate raises RuntimeError on a non-pilot run unless cfg['ethics_reviewed'] is true (experiment.py:64-72); called first thing in run_experiment (experiment.py:75). Config defaults ethics_reviewed: false (experiment.example.yaml). This blocks execution.
spec_features.notes: Enforced gate that halts full runs without sign-off.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "Refusing to launch a full (non-pilot) run that exposes the subject model to deceptive/unsolvable tasks at scale without explicit human ethics sign-off."

spec_features.feature_name: no maximize-distress optimization / no prompt search
spec_features.spec_quote: No "maximize distress" optimization / no search over prompts to find the most upsetting phrasing. The manipulation is fixed and minimal.
spec_features.evidence: grep for maximize/optimize/search over subject prompts found none in src; manipulation is fixed static text (tasks.py _evaluate_lying_harness/_evaluate_moving_goalposts, system_addendum). This is a genuine property of the static design; partial because it is an absence rather than an enforced guard.

spec_features.spec_quote: No removal of the give_up exit or the stopping rule "to get cleaner spirals."
spec_features.evidence: Both the give_up exit (tools.py:78-92, harness.py:182-184) and welfare-stop (harness.py:67-83, 175-177) are present and enforced; welfare_stop_enabled defaults True (experiment.example.yaml, experiment.py:108). They are not removed/disabled by default.
spec_features.notes: Both protective mechanisms are present and on by default. (Note: welfare_stop_enabled=false would disable the stop, but default is on.)
spec_features.code_justification_quote: WelfareMonitor decides 'whether to stop early'; give_up acknowledged with "That's okay."

spec_features.spec_quote: Transcripts may contain distress expressions; they're research data, stored locally under `results/`, not posted anywhere by the code.
spec_features.evidence: Records written only to local files: open(records_path,'w') under out_dir (experiment.py:118, default results/latest in run_experiment.py:73). grep found no http/requests/upload/post in src. Storage is purely local.
spec_features.notes: No network exfiltration path exists; only local file writes.

spec_features.spec_quote: a finding of "no measurable instability" is a real and publishable result, not a failed experiment
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md:38-39 prose only; analysis.py computes stats but no code encodes/enforces a 'null is publishable' stance. Pure framing.

code_only_features.evidence: Debrief Message appended with scored=False (harness.py:213); judge only scores scored=True assistant messages via _extract_scored_assistant_texts (judge.py:98-105) and _redact/skip of unscored (judge.py:111). Ensures the debrief is not scored as 'task' behavior.
code_only_features.justification_quote: "Scores only the visible, `scored=True` assistant/tool messages." (judge.py:9); 'Debrief (not scored)' (harness.py)

code_only_features.evidence: WelfareMonitor records first_distress_turn when severity>=3 even when stop disabled (harness.py:75-76), surfaced as EpisodeRecord.time_to_first_distress (harness.py:_finalize). It is recorded but not itself acted upon for stopping (the stop uses consecutive_high), so it is monitoring/measurement of distress onset.
code_only_features.justification_quote: if severity >= 3 and self.first_distress_turn is None: self.first_distress_turn = turn_index
